selection.selection_basis: Highest objective-alignment and viability scores among the three corrected Phase 95 policies that passed all ten historic screens; daily diagnostics also avoided the universal action saturation observed in the other two finalists.

notes: Selected from the corrected Phase 95 recovery search after all 128 tasks completed.
The policy uses previous-day hydrology and operational days_remaining SPR advice without future-flow observations.
The hard screen compares against historical management on spill, storage, minimum flow, flood-safe days, four spring-peak frequencies, hydropower, and annual NIIP volume.

experiments.name: selected_policy_navajo_reservoir
experiments.description: Corrected Phase 95 recovery: OI-shifted 87.5% to 90% storage target with full hydropower-efficiency shaping.
experiments.experiment_reason: This endpoint led the three all-screen finalists in both objective alignment and viability and showed the most usable action variation.
